lesson: Small scale (0.3-0.8) is a strong, repeatable lever for SCRATCHES (C2 0.793 vs C1 0.661, +0.13) but NEUTRAL for inclusion (0.435-0.463 vs default 0.468) — it did not fix the small-inclusion misses, so don't assume small misses need small pastes. Restricting inclusion sources to thin streaks was strongly harmful (C3 inclusion 0.362, scratches 0.614), so keep uniform/all sources. For R3: keep scratches at small scale, and push inclusion with DEFAULT scale + higher allocation (the R1 lever that took it 0.258->0.460) rather than small scale; keep patches at default (small scale hurt them in R1).
